sections.theory:
Exercise questions

1. Choose and write the suitable answers.

i. The game of basketball began in ________ .

(a) America  (b) England  (c) Germany  (d) European Union

ii. Basketball began in ________ .

(a) 1889  (b) 1891  (c) 1893  (d) 1895

iii. The minimum weight of the basketball is ________ grams.

(a) 563  (b) 565  (c) 567  (d) 569

iv. The length of the basketball court is ________ metres.

(a) 24  (b) 26  (c) 28  (d) 30

v. The breadth of the basketball court is ________ metres.

(a) 15  (b) 17  (c) 19  (d) 21

vi. The thickness of all the lines of the basketball court is ________ centimetres.

(a) 3  (b) 5  (c) 7  (d) 9

vii. In basketball the radius of the centre circle is ________ .

(a) 1.80 metres  (b) 1.85 metres  (c) 1.90 metres  (d) 1.95 metres

viii. In basketball the length of the backboard is ________ metres.

(a) 1.26  (b) 1.24  (c) 1.22  (d) 1.20
